backup.production_rule: s102 (Lloyd 2026-10-31: tasks and notifications close themselves once the problem is fixed). public.system_tasks_sweep_v1() runs hourly (pg_cron system-tasks-sweep, minute 50, as postgres, no grants) and closes OPEN system tasks: guest_details when the guest is no longer returned by guests_missing_details_v1 or no confirmed stay checks in on the ref date; missed_cleaning when a cleaning_sessions row of the property has that checkout date or no confirmed stay checks out that day (no lookback, so aged-out real problems stay open); meter_no_photo and meter_estimate_waiting when no meter_readings row of that session is estimate_pending. A malformed ref is skipped. low_stock and verifier findings already close themselves and are untouched. meter_settle_estimates_v1(uuid) is replaced with the live body (md5 of replace(prosrc, chr(13), '') before: e3eaf07237d1fdfb39ac3d643d0bd6a3) changed in one place: the B reading also counts when vision_verdict is mismatch and vision_resolved_at is not null (an admin answered it in s101).
backup.notes: Phase expand: one function added, one replaced (grants restated: service_role only), one cron job. No table or column change. Nothing in the apps calls the sweep. First sweep after apply closes the stale live tasks (about 5 of 8 guest_details whose details are on file, missed_cleaning 2026-10-16 which has no confirmed stay); 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-25 stay open until their reports exist.

forward_verification.name: sweep_function_exists_once
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc where pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and proname = 'system_tasks_sweep_v1'

forward_verification.name: sweep_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select (prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc where oid = 'public.system_tasks_sweep_v1()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: sweep_has_no_grants
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.system_tasks_sweep_v1()', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.system_tasks_sweep_v1()', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.system_tasks_sweep_v1()', 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.system_tasks_sweep_v1()'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: cron_job_system_tasks_sweep
forward_verification.query: select case when to_regclass('cron.job') is null then true else (xpath('/row/s/text()', query_to_xml('select (count(*) = 1)::text s from cron.job where jobname = ''system-tasks-sweep'' and active and schedule = ''50 * * * *'' and command like ''%system_tasks_sweep_v1%''', false, true, '')))[1]::text = 'true' end

forward_verification.name: meter_settle_counts_an_answered_mismatch
forward_verification.query: select position('vision_resolved_at is not null' in prosrc) > 0 from pg_proc where oid = 'public.meter_settle_estimates_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: meter_settle_grants_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.meter_settle_estimates_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.meter_settle_estimates_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.meter_settle_estimates_v1(uuid)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: dependencies_exist
forward_verification.query: select to_regprocedure('public.guests_missing_details_v1(uuid[])') is not null and to_regprocedure('public.system_task_open_v1(uuid,text,text,text,text,text)') is not null and to_regprocedure('public.s_meter_nights_v1(uuid)') is not null

rollback.safe_until: Always. The rollback script unschedules system-tasks-sweep, drops system_tasks_sweep_v1 and restores the previous meter_settle_estimates_v1 body verbatim. Tasks the sweep already closed stay done: reopen one by hand from Follow-ups if it was closed wrongly.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_cron_job_is_the_switch
feature_flags.required_state: None. Unscheduling system-tasks-sweep (select cron.unschedule('system-tasks-sweep')) switches the sweep off.

compatibility.evidence: PENDING - rehearsal on a fresh backup: migration applied 1/1, forward checks, pgTAP s102_task_sweep.sql (35 tests). Written without a local PostgreSQL; not executed on the build host.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point is empty or verified_at is empty
the rehearsal has not run the migration and s102_task_sweep.sql green on this commit, compatibility.verified is still false
the live md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) of meter_settle_estimates_v1 is not e3eaf07237d1fdfb39ac3d643d0bd6a3 at apply time (the replaced body would drop a newer live change)
the Opus 5.5 review of this SQL lane (an automatic closer of tasks that Lloyd and staff act on) has not passed
